### Props

| Name        | Type     | Required | Default               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `position`  | `string` |          | `'bottom-right'`      | Default position for the FAB.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `chatAppId` | `string` |          | `DEFAULT_CHAT_APP_ID` | Backend app id that answers the chat/health/conversation HTTP calls (`/index.php/apps/{chatAppId}/api/...`). Single configuration point for the AI Chat Companion's backend — see composables/aiChatConfig.js. Defaults to `openregister`; `CnAppRoot` forwards its own `chatAppId` prop here so a consuming app can point the widget at another backend (e.g. `hermiq`) in one place. Per hydra ADR-034 "Amendment 2026-07-05" the default flip to `hermiq` is a deferred, coordinated change. |
